描述_EN: the stoneware body of this plate has been glazed in a modified version of the sancai three-colour scheme of the tang dynasty, known as song sancai. the term cizhou encapsulates a range of wares made in several regions of northern china, often consisting of a stoneware body decorated with a bold design. the effect is a crisp and bold design in striking colours. the outlines of this lively design have been carved into the body to avoid the spread of the glazes during firing. this dish is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty.
描述_ZN: 此盘的石器主体已被施以唐代三彩计划的改进版，称为宋三彩。 术语 "Cizhou "概括了中国北方几个地区制造的一系列器物，通常由一个石器主体装饰着大胆的设计。 效果是一个清晰而大胆的设计，颜色醒目。 这个生动的图案的轮廓已经被刻在了盘体上，以避免烧制过程中釉料的扩散。 这只盘子是慈溪器皿的一个例子，慈溪器皿是中国北方地区在金代制造的一种陶瓷类型。
